annotations.title: Get CBP Use of Force by Area

description: Look up a CBP area of responsibility in the Border Force Register, built from CBP's own monthly use-of-force and assault files (FY2021 on), by sector or field-office name substring. An area is a CBP office's area or unit (a Border Patrol sector, an OFO field office or a national unit), never a city or an operation; CBP's own service-area statement is quoted where CBP gives one. Returns yearly figures, or monthly figures for one fiscal_year: use-of-force incidents with their force types (force totals include vehicle and vessel force, such as tire-deflation devices), officers/agents using force, assault incidents, and officers/agents assaulted. Officers assaulted and officers using force are counted per incident: one officer in two incidents counts twice, and neither is a count of people injured. The current fiscal year is labelled partial. No rates (nothing is divided by encounters or staffing) and no causation: CBP's files do not say why counts change. A non-match says only that the name is not in CBP's files.

area.description: Required CBP sector or field-office name substring, at most 80 characters; an area is a CBP office area, never a city or an operation.

fiscal_year.description: Optional federal fiscal year from 2021 (FY2026 began October 2025); when set, returns that year month by month.
